activity.notes: Joseph II became Holy Roman Emperor in 1765 and remained emperor until his death in 1790. ATLAS records this imperial office separately from his existing Habsburg Monarchy co-regency (1765-1780) and sole rule (1780-1790).

sources.title: Joseph II — Die Welt der Habsburger
sources.citation_text: The Habsburg history portal identifies Joseph II as Emperor of the Holy Roman Empire from 1765 to 1790, while separately listing his co-regency and sole rule in the Habsburg Monarchy.
